60273-leave-it-to-doris.title: Leave It To Doris
60273-leave-it-to-doris.creator: Ethel Hueston
60273-leave-it-to-doris.description: A book by Ethel Hueston. d her lips earnestly over a too-small scrap of cloth vainly coping with a too-large rent. Her father went to the door opening upon the porch, and closed it also. Then he walked slowly up toward his daughter, opening his lips as though on the verge of confidence. But he turned once more, and resumed his restless pacing.

arxiv-2107-13828.title: The variational approach to s s -fractional heat flows and the limit cases s → 0 + s\to 0^{+} and s → 1 − s\to 1^{-}
arxiv-2107-13828.creator: V. Crismale, L. De Luca, A. Kubin, A. Ninno, M. Ponsiglione
arxiv-2107-13828.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by V. Crismale, L. De Luca, A. Kubin, A. Ninno, M. Ponsiglione. This paper deals with the limit cases for s s -fractional heat flows in a cylindrical domain, with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions, as s → 0 + s\to 0^{+} and s → 1 − s\to 1^{-} . To this purpose, we describe the fractional heat flows as minimizing movements of the corresponding Gagliardo seminorms, with respect to the L 2 L^{2} metric.

arxiv-2208-11123.title: An explicit version of Bombieri’s log-free density estimate and Sárközy’s theorem for shifted primes
arxiv-2208-11123.creator: Jesse Thorner, Asif Zaman
arxiv-2208-11123.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jesse Thorner, Asif Zaman. We make explicit Bombieri’s refinement of Gallagher’s log-free “large sieve density estimate near σ = 1 \sigma=1 ” for Dirichlet L L -functions. We use this estimate and recent work of Green to prove that if N ≥ 2 N\geq 2 is an integer, A ⊆ { 1 , … , N } A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\} , and for all primes p p no two elements in A A differ by p − 1 p-1 , then | A | ≪ N

arxiv-2212-08195.title: Improving Chess Commentaries by Combining Language Models with Symbolic Reasoning Engines
arxiv-2212-08195.creator: Andrew Lee David Wu Emily Dinan Mike Lewis
arxiv-2212-08195.description: Abstract Despite many recent advancements in language modeling, state-of-the-art language models lack grounding in the real world and struggle with tasks involving complex reasoning. Meanwhile, advances in the symbolic reasoning capabilities of AI have led to systems that outperform humans in games like chess and Go ( Silver et al. 2018 ) .

arxiv-2312-09508.title: IndicIRSuite: Multilingual Dataset and Neural Information Models for Indian Languages
arxiv-2312-09508.creator: Saiful Haq, Ashutosh Sharma, Pushpak Bhattacharyya
arxiv-2312-09508.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Saiful Haq, Ashutosh Sharma, Pushpak Bhattacharyya. In this paper, we introduce Neural Information Retrieval resources for 11 widely spoken Indian Languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Oriya, Punjabi, Tamil, and Telugu) from two major Indian language families (Indo-Aryan and Dravidian).

arxiv-2401-07585.title: String interactions as a source of collective behaviour
arxiv-2401-07585.creator: Christian Bierlich
arxiv-2401-07585.description: Abstract MCnet-24-01 Abstract The discovery of collective effects in small collision systems, have spurred a renewed interest in hadronization models, also as a source for collective effects all the way to large collision systems, where they are usually ascribed to the creation of a Quark–Gluon Plasma.

arxiv-2508-19872.title: Jupiter Trojans spectrophotometry using Gaia DR3 catalog
arxiv-2508-19872.creator: S. Fornasier, N. El-Bez-Sebastien
arxiv-2508-19872.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by S. Fornasier, N. El-Bez-Sebastien. Jupiter Trojans are considered to be among the most pristine Solar System bodies. They may have originated from the Kuiper belt, and were captured by Jupiter during planetary migrations. We present the spectral characterization of Jupiter Trojans using data from the third data release by the Gaia mission (DR3) spectral catalog and from the literature, the analysis of the spectral slope correlations with physical parameters, and the comparison with the outer Solar System bodies main properties.

arxiv-2512-05533.title: From Challenge to Change: Design Principles for AI Transformations Journal: Journal of Systems and Software
arxiv-2512-05533.creator: Theocharis Tavantzis, Stefano Lambiase, Daniel Russo, Robert Feldt
arxiv-2512-05533.description: Abstract The rapid rise of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies is reshaping Software Engineering (SE) practice, unlocking new opportunities while introducing human-centered challenges. Although prior research acknowledges behavioral and other non-technical factors affecting AI integration, most studies still emphasize technical concerns and offer limited insight into how teams adapt to and trust AI systems.

arxiv-2601-09170.title: N-EIoU-YOLOv9: A Signal-Aware Bounding Box Regression Loss for Lightweight Mobile Detection of Rice Leaf Diseases Journal: Nuclear Physics B
arxiv-2601-09170.creator: Dung Ta Nguyen Duc, Thanh Bui Dang, Hoang Le Minh, Tung Nguyen Viet, Huong Nguyen Thanh, Dong Trinh Cong
arxiv-2601-09170.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Dung Ta Nguyen Duc, Thanh Bui Dang, Hoang Le Minh, Tung Nguyen Viet, Huong Nguyen Thanh, Dong Trinh Cong. Early and accurate detection of rice leaf diseases is critical for precision agriculture, yet deploying high-performance object detection models on resource-constrained mobile devices remains a significant challenge. In this work, we propose N-EIoU-YOLOv9, a lightweight detection framework centered on a signal-aware bounding box regression loss derived from non-monotonic gradient focusing and geometric decoupling principles, termed N-EIoU (Non-monotonic Efficient Intersection over Union).

pmc-10744625.title: Trichoderma harzianum Cellulase Gene thph2 Affects Trichoderma Root Colonization and Induces Resistance to Southern Leaf Blight in Maize
pmc-10744625.creator: Bo Lang, Jie Chen, Michael H Perlin
pmc-10744625.description: Trichoderma, widely distributed all over the world, is commonly found in soil and root ecosystems. It is a group comprising beneficial fungi that improve plant disease resistance and promote plant growth. Studies have shown that Trichoderma cellulases can also improve plant disease resistance.

pmc-11548275.title: Study on Optimal Nitrogen Application for Different Oat Varieties in Dryland Regions of the Loess Plateau
pmc-11548275.creator: Yuejing Qiao, Luming Zhao, Duo Gao, Lijing Zhang, Laichun Guo, Junyong Ge, Yaqi Fan, Yiyu Wang, Zhixia Yan
pmc-11548275.description: The present study endeavored to tackle the challenges posed by limited diversity in oat varieties and suboptimal nitrogen fertilizer utilization in the arid landscapes of the Loess Plateau. We selected three oat varieties, including early-maturing oats (E), medium-maturing oats (M), and late-maturing oats (L).

pmc-12467870.title: Synergistic Effects of Gibberellic Acid, Forchlorfenuron, Thidiazuron, and Brassinosteroid Combinations on Seedless Berry Development and Quality Enhancement in ‘Shine Muscat’ and ‘Red Muscat of Alexandria’ Grapes
pmc-12467870.creator: Pengcheng Yang, Zishu Wu, Boyang Liu, Lei Wang, Shiping Wang
pmc-12467870.description: Simple SummaryMarket analysis indicates that large, seedless grapes with good flavor are highly popular. To investigate this, we evaluated the effects of five plant growth regulators—gibberellic acid (GA), 24-epibrassinolide (EBR), forchlorfenuron (CPPU), thidiazuron (TDZ), and streptomycin (SM)—on two grape varieties ‘Shine Muscat’ and ‘Red Muscat of Alexandria’.

pmc-12512860.title: Beyond NT-proBNP and troponin: How machine learning redefines light-chain cardiac amyloidosis risk assessment
pmc-12512860.creator: Danni Wu, Xiaohang Liu, Xinhao Li, Jia Chen, Xue Lin, Ligang Fang, Wei Chen
pmc-12512860.description: ObjectiveTo develop and validate a machine learning-based prognostic model that provides enhanced risk stratification for AL cardiac amyloidosis patients beyond existing staging system.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective cohort study of newly diagnosed AL cardiac amyloidosis patients (2006–2024), randomly allocating participants into training and test sets (8:2 ratio).

pmc-12598923.title: Brain organoid models of Huntington's disease shift the focus towards neurodevelopment
pmc-12598923.creator: Wenqing Xu, Alessandro Prigione
pmc-12598923.description: Huntington's disease (HD) is traditionally viewed as an age-related disorder. Emerging evidence suggests that mutant huntingtin (mHTT) disrupts early neurodevelopment, although the contribution of developmental alterations to the late disease onset remains to be clarified. Leveraging human pluripotent stem cell-derived brain organoids, we and others are exploring how mHTT affects the developing human brain.

pmc-12659495.title: Adenylate kinase 5, a novel genetic risk factor for Alzheimer’s disease, regulates microglial inflammatory activation
pmc-12659495.creator: Won Jae Seong, Sang Joon An, Jungsoo Gim, Deepak Prasad Gupta, Junyoung Park, Sarang Kang, Kun Ho Lee, Gyun Jee Song
pmc-12659495.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by memory loss, cognitive decline, and neuroinflammation, primarily mediated by microglia. In this study, we investigate the role of adenylate kinase 5 (AK5) in microglial function and its association with AD-related pathology. Analysis of brain tissues from AD patients and AD model mice revealed a significant reduction in AK5 expression.

pmc-12734376.title: Association Between Serum Ionized Calcium Levels and Neurological Outcomes in Patients with Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest
pmc-12734376.creator: Shin Young Park, Hyun-Soo Zhang, Incheol Park, Je Sung You, Yoo Seok Park, Yu-Jang Su
pmc-12734376.description: Despite advances in post-cardiac arrest care, mortality and poor neurological outcomes remain common after out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA). Calcium imbalance is characteristic of post-cardiac arrest syndrome, but its prognostic role is unclear. We retrospectively analyzed 421 OHCA patients treated with targeted temperature management (TTM) (2011–2023).

pmc-13014446.title: CHARMM-GUI Hybrid ML/MM Builder for Hybrid Machine Learning and Molecular Mechanical Modeling and Simulations
pmc-13014446.creator: Florence Szczepaniak, Donghyuk Suh, Wonpil Im
pmc-13014446.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Recent advances in machine learning (ML) have enabled new developments in molecular dynamics simulation. Neural network potentials (NNPs) trained on quantum mechanical (QM) data provide highly accurate descriptions of drug-like molecules. Analogous to a QM and molecular mechanical (QM/MM) approach, hybrid ML/MM simulations employ NNPs to describe a localized region of the system, such as a ligand, while the rest of the system is treated using classical MM force fields.
